title: Ted Schlein’s Ballistic Ventures seeks $490M for new funds amid AI-driven cybersecurity boom
slides: Can Ballistic Ventures raise $490M before rivals crowd in?
It's targeting two new funds simultaneously
But the cybersecurity LP pool is tighter than headlines suggest
Founders pitching soon will face sharper diligence on AI claims
Watch whether Ballistic closes above or below target
thread_text:
1. $490M Before the Crowd

Ballistic Ventures is raising two funds at once while the cybersecurity LP pool tightens. The clock is ticking before rivals move in.

2. Two Funds, One Bet

Running parallel vehicles lets the firm scale fast, but it also doubles the fundraising load and splits attention.

3. LP Pool Is Shrinking

Headlines suggest endless cyber cash, but the actual pool of limited partners writing big checks is smaller than it looks.

4. Diligence Gets Sharper

Founders pitching AI security claims soon will face harder questions on proof, not just potential.

5. Will They Hit Target?

Watch whether Ballistic closes above or below $490M. If you're raising, ask yourself: would your deck survive that scrutiny today?
